newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates steady to down on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates steady to down on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were mostly steady to lower in thin Friday dealings on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none on Thursday.
- Two barges, next week, Illinois river, no bid, offered 180 percent.
- Two barges, next week, Mississippi (St Paul-Savage), no bid, offered 200 percent.
- One barge, next week, lower Ohio river, no bid, offered 185 percent, down five percentage points.
- Four barges, two each week of September 22 and September 29, Mid-Mississippi, no bid, offered 210 percent, unchanged.
- Four barges, two each week of September 22 and September 29, Illinois river, no bid, offered 205 percent.
- Four barges, one each week of October, Illinois river, bid 225 percent of tariff, similar unchanged, no offer.
